text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today marks the start of our US inspection 
trip. I want to learn as much as possible 
before heading back—

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Ah, found my inspection buddy! Looking 
forward to the next few days together♪
choice_data_list:
Wait, you're a student and you're on the 
team?!

Wait, you're a student and you're on the 
team?!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? Well, normally it's just Trainers, 
but... there's no rule saying students 
can't be assigned, right? Plus, the 
Chairwoman approved the proposal♪
choice_data_list: Huh!? You, a student, are a member!?
Huh!? You, a student, are a member!?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
There's a race I've been kinda curious 
about. I really wanted to watch it live 
and soak in the atmosphere!
choice_data_list: I-In that case... maybe it's fine.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
While we're at it, I also wanna hit up my 
favorite hat shop. Imported items have 
differences in materials and designs when 
you see them in physical stores, after 
all—
choice_data_list: (...She's as active as ever.)

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Mmm! LA really is the best, isn't it?♪ 
It's so vibrant, and super easy to hit up 
multiple racetracks!
choice_data_list: (...Always such an energetic girl, huh.)

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Though having the racing museum so far 
away is kind of a bummer. Tons of fans 
want to see the exhibits and all—
choice_data_list:
Kentucky's where it's at, but yeah, it 
really is pretty far.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
It wouldn't be quite the same as an actual 
museum, but... what if we set up something 
at the track to make up for it?
choice_data_list: There's one in Kentucky, but that's a bit too far.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Like placing QR codes all over the venue, 
so when you scan 'em, you can view 
exhibits and commentary tied to the 
racetrack right on your phone!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
If we render 3D models with AR, people 
could look from any angle and size they 
want— Boom, you get the museum vibe right 
on-site, right?
choice_data_list: That's awesome, sounds super fun!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, that was so much fun! American movie 
theaters are so lively, you know? Everyone 
just gets together and has a blast.
choice_data_list: Sounds good, that sounds fun!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
In Japan, outside of cheer screenings or 
live concert viewings, people mostly just 
sit quietly and watch—

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Oh! What about doing live race viewings in 
movie theaters? We've had public viewings 
at racetracks before, but those locations 
are pretty limited, right?
choice_data_list:
True... doing it in movie theaters would 
open it up to way more people!

True... doing it in movie theaters would 
open it up to way more people!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Also, an "Interactive 4D 
Screening: Relive Legendary Races from the 
Winning Horse Girl's Point of View!" would 
totally have massive demand♪
choice_data_list: True... A movie theater would make it accessible to a lot more people!
True... A movie theater would make it accessible to a lot more people!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Here it is, here it is—! Del Mar 
Racetrack! The home turf that crowns the 
world's strongest at the BC Classic!
choice_data_list: Honestly, I just want to watch that myself...!
Honestly, I just want to watch that myself...!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Well duh, just standing in such an epic 
place gets your hype levels through the 
roof! Like, "Holy crap, this is THE 
place?!"♪
choice_data_list: There's still quite a crowd even on non-race days, huh.
There's still quite a crowd even on non-race days, isn't there.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. Everyone really does love racing 
after all, huh?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
...You know, maybe we should just go all 
out and build a theme park or an entire 
city where people can fully immerse 
themselves in racing♪
choice_data_list: Isn't that scale a bit too massive?!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
You think so? If we pull it off, it'd 
totally work, and seeing it happen would 
be ultra-hype, wouldn't it?♪
choice_data_list: Isn't that a little too grand in scale!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Afterward, we inspected various other 
locations, and I was continually exposed 
to her flexible and captivating ideas.
choice_data_list: That's............ well, point taken.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Idea after idea burst forth from her 
without stopping. Yet every single one of 
those inspirations was rooted deeply in 
racing.
choice_data_list: (...She really is an incredible girl.)

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad the weather cleared up today! 
It's the ultimate day for race spectating♪
choice_data_list: (...She really is an incredible girl.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was still time before the race we 
planned to watch— On the way to the 
stands, I posed a question that had been 
lingering in my mind.
choice_data_list:
Do you plan on doing business outside of 
racing in the future?

Do you plan on doing business outside of 
racing in the future?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Knowing her, she would likely be able to 
display her talents across a wide range of 
fields. Thinking that, I asked her—
choice_data_list: Are you going to branch out into non-racing business going forward?
Will you be doing work outside of racing from now on?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Nope.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —An immediate, unexpected answer.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Sure, there are plenty of big chances 
rolling around in fields other than 
racing. ...I've even been invited to join 
a few times.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
But that's not what this is about. This is 
about what I cherish at my absolute core—

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
The pure, burning excitement and the 
romance that sets my heart on fire.

text_block_list.name: Young Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa...! She's zooming so fast, she 
crossed the finish line in a blink of an 
eye, daddy?!

text_block_list.name: Young Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
What's a record break? Does it just mean 
she's super duper insane?!

text_block_list.name: Young's Father
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's right. In this race—with that 
girl's running, history was just made.

text_block_list.name: Young Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
So cool, so cool! That big sister came 
from all the way in the back and—she 
passed the girl in first!

text_block_list.name: Young's Father
text_block_list.text:
She came all the way from Japan just like 
you, burning with the desire to win 
overseas. ...Come on, let's cheer for her.

text_block_list.name: Young Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Go, go! You can do it—!

text_block_list.name: Young Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
—Waaahhh! Big sister got first place! Yay, 
yay!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Racing gave me an endless sense of 
romance. It taught me what real, genuine 
fervor feels like.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
So... I guess you could call it giving 
back? I want to return the favor to the 
racing world with my own two hands.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
That blazing passion I encountered back 
then... No, I'm gonna create an even 
crazier, world-shaking innovation myself!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
To make the racing world a far more epic 
place— Because I can see so many 
possibilities!
choice_data_list: ...That's a really huge dream.

With that mindset, you're bound to 
succeed!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Thanks♪ But, you know—
choice_data_list: ...That's a really big dream.
With that determination, you're sure to succeed!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
It's not just a dream, it's a locked-in 
vision of the future!
choice_data_list:
Locked in, huh... You just might actually 
pull it off.

Locked in, huh... You just might actually 
pull it off.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Go, go! You can do it—!
choice_data_list: A sure thing, huh... You just might be able to pull it off.
A sure thing, huh... You just might be able to pull it off.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Hehe, thanks!
choice_data_list: Power straight through to the finishã¼ã¼ã¼!!

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Grown-ups usually say stuff like "that's 
too hard" or "isn't that impossible?" 
though—

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
You actually believe I can do it, don't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
You actually believe I can do it, don't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text: Go, go! You can do it—!
choice_data_list:
Keep pushing straight through to the 
end—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We became so enthralled and captivated by 
the sheer power of the race that we 
completely forgot we were here on an 
inspection.
choice_data_list: Power straight through to the finishã¼ã¼ã¼!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (Woooooooahh!)
choice_data_list: Yeah... There's no other world that gets you this fired up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Before long, amidst thunderous cheers, 
the horse girl running in the lead crossed 
the finish line in gallant fashion.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Man, totally satisfied! Super glad we got 
to watch it live on-site♪
choice_data_list: Yeah, it was a great race.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
Just you watch. I'm gonna hype up the 
whole world just like that too!
choice_data_list: Yeah, it was a good race.

text_block_list.name: Forever Young
text_block_list.text:
For that, first comes prep work— I'm gonna 
go talk to the people I set appointments 
with, 'kay?♪
